headline: PII Reveals Guarantee for Whoosh Debt of Rp2 Trillion, Here Is the Scheme
summary: PT PII received a guarantee of Rp2 trillion on debt for the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway project, known as Whoosh (KCJB). The guarantee scheme was described in the report.
why: Whoosh is Indonesia's high-speed rail project, and government-backed debt guarantees affect its financing costs and the sovereign's contingent liabilities.
original_headline: PII Ungkap Jaminan Utang Whoosh Rp2 Triliun, Ini Skemanya
